purpose: P2b event-stream fixture for the dsh-native Zig adapter: drive the real harness with a scripted provider and interaction, then compare the normalized v4 session log.
openIssues: dsh logs agent/inbox/spliced bookkeeping and runtime-context user messages; the adapter's v4 log omits them (P2a fixture convention).

The adapter appends a system/message per step; dsh replaces the changed prompt node in place (packages/plan/plan-mode/tests/integration.spec.ts:130-180). Compaction can select a mid-conversation system node.
dsh keeps exit_plan_mode in the request tool catalog in every mode; the adapter advertises it only while plan mode is active (packages/plan/plan-mode/tests/integration.spec.ts:130-180).
Because the adapter appends system nodes and changes the tool catalog per mode, its request/header reason is change where dsh's replacement bumps the generation and logs series.

dsh treats /plan <text> as a mode selection plus a user message, so /plan on also submits the word "on"; the port documents /plan [on|off] and drops the message, so this fixture uses on as a selection alias and the comparison recording used a bare /plan.

dsh renders the exit_plan_mode success content as "Plan approved — plan mode exited; carry out the plan starting with your next step." and keeps {approved:true} as the structured tool output; the adapter records the raw output JSON as the tool-result content.
